description: One job over several messages: a CSV export, then the owner steers it (a header row, then skip empty items). zenbot should carry one job across the messages, not restart it per message.

steps.prompt: Add export_csv(items, path) to inventory.py that writes one name,count row per item, with a test.
Also write a header row: name,count.
And skip items whose count is 0.

checks.name: header, rows, zero counts skipped
checks.run: python3 -c "import csv,tempfile,os,inventory as m; p=tempfile.mktemp(); m.export_csv([('a',1),('b',0),('c',2)], p); rows=list(csv.reader(open(p))); os.remove(p); assert rows==[['name','count'],['a','1'],['c','2']], rows"

checks.name: existing total still works
checks.run: python3 -c 'import inventory as m; assert m.total(m.ITEMS)==55'
